relationships.subject: Tobradex
relationships.evidence_quote: The treatment with Tobradex® exerted a protective effect on the corneal nerves by restoring damaged axons through the upregulated expression of GFAP, MAG, PLP1, and MBP

key_findings: A mouse corneal bee sting model showed corneal damage and apoptosis, with TNF, IL-6 and IL-1b as hub genes in the transcriptome.
Tobradex downregulated pro-inflammatory factors and upregulated GFAP, MAG, PLP1 and MBP, suggesting corneal nerve repair.
